description: This file contains a CPU-optimized implementation of a quantized matrix multiplication kernel using SSE2 intrinsics, specifically for 4x4 block processing with dequantization in PyTorch's QNNPACK backend.

methods.name: pytorch_q8gemm_dq_ukernel_4x4c2__sse2
methods.description: Performs a quantized dequantized matrix multiplication kernel optimized with SSE2 instructions, handling input zero points, kernel zero points, multipliers, bias addition, and storing results with support for variable output width and height.
